uniform_steady.description: Uniform (a,b,c) maximizing a. After 10 iterations from x in [0.01, 1], output must be within epsilon of 1.

perstep_finite.description: Per-step coefficients [(a1,b1,c1),...,(a5,b5,c5)] maximizing a1. After exactly 5 steps from [x_min, x_max], output must be within epsilon of 1. x_max = 1/1.02 reflects safety-factor normalization.

uniform_tight.description: Uniform (a,b,c) maximizing a. Same structure as uniform_steady but tighter: after 10 iterations, output within epsilon=0.05 of 1.
